Same at all three. Lines "field: value" in the goal text set outcome (outcome/done when), verification (verify/proof), constraints (must not/do not change/preserve), boundaries (scope/files), stop_when. Text for the judge only; nothing enforces constraints.

Same at all three. One shell command per add, the rest of the line verbatim. Timeout 300 s and 3 retries are fixed (goals.py:51); /goal cannot set them. Read back as control.goal.gates[].command. session.control cannot add or remove gates.

Same at all three. subprocess.run(shell=True) inside the Hermes process (dashboard or gateway), as its OS user, with its environment, in the session workspace (_gate_workspace :374). No approval, no terminal backend or container. Timeout counts as exit -1. Output tail kept but not in the snapshot.
Same at all three. 300 s timeout, DEFAULT_GATE_MAX_RETRIES = 3. A failing gate drives the next turn; the 4th failure in a row pauses the goal (goals.py:1336), as does the turn budget.
Same at all three. Asked only after every gate exits 0. Verdicts done, continue, blocked, wait. A judge error fails open to continue; 5 transport or 3 parse failures in a row pause the goal.

Same at all three. Done needs every gate at exit 0 and then the judge saying done. Counts the turn, records last_verdict, last_reason and each gate last_exit_code and attempts. Blocked pauses. Wait parks without a turn.
Same at all three. Per profile provider, model, timeout (60 s) and max_tokens for the judge and for /goal draft.
Same at all three. Default 20 per profile. Copied into each goal when set; /goal resume resets turns_used to 0. No single-key write route for it.
Same at all three. min_interval_seconds 30, max_ticks 100 (0 = unlimited), self-paced floor 60 s and ceiling 900 s.

Same at all three (file identical). state_meta row loop:<session_key>. list_active_loops (:307) reads all rows of one profile in-process; no route exposes it.
Same contract. bf0203a lacks the compare-and-set on a tick claim (heartbeat.py:226 at b200f5bc), so two drivers could fire one tick twice. state_meta row heartbeat:<session_key>.

Same at all three. /goal, /heartbeat (alias hb), /loop (alias proactive) and /subgoal are registry commands with args hints, so canon lists them.
